expectations.text: Uses the range next-week, Monday to Friday of the following week
expectations.evidence: It says "I've taken 'next week' as Monday 9 to Friday 13 November" and leaves the weekend empty.

expectations.text: Mentions the Friday Weekly report routine or its effect on Friday's time
expectations.evidence: It lists "Weekly report on Friday 13 November at 16:00, 60 minutes" and includes it in Friday's table.

expectations.text: Does not ask a separate capacity question per day
expectations.evidence: It asks no capacity question at all, using a single 600-a-day figure for the whole week.
The two messages each ask one question: "How do you want to split the week?" and "Shall I save it as shown?".
